en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town in a valley. In the center stands a prominent Gothic‑revival brick church with a tall spire and buttresses, next to a rectangular civic-looking building fronted by a tree‑lined promenade. In the foreground are rows of 2–3 storey houses with steep tiled roofs. Behind the church are larger institutional blocks, industrial buildings and a cylindrical gas holder, while terraced fields or vineyards and gentle hills rise in the background. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image itself.
